evidence: XRR measurements allowed correlating the density of the as-deposited HTO films with its hafnium content. Rutherford backscattering spectrometry measurements were performed to determine the composition of the films. X-ray diffraction measurements were performed on a series of HTO compositions. Ellipsometry was used to measure the film thickness. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy was used to analyze the chemical composition. Four-point probe and Hall Effect measurements were used to study the electrical properties. Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) measurements were performed to determine the dielectric constant. Grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIS-XRD) was used to study the crystallization behavior. Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) were used to study the surface morphology. Electrical measurements (leakage current, dielectric constant) were performed to evaluate the electrical properties.
